module: Flowgraph node 'Camera Auto Circle' (once_p_duration category). Rotates the free camera in a circle around a vehicle (vehId, default player vehicle) or a point (centerPos): radius 'radius' (5 by default), height 'height', angular speed 'speed' in degrees/s (10 by default, negative for the opposite direction), start angle 'startAngle' (relative to the vehicle's orientation if vehId is given), 'snapHeight' to follow the terrain. The camera always looks at the center.
notes: The angle advances with mgr.dtReal (real time, not simulation).
The center follows the center of the vehicle's bounding box (OOBB) every frame.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets center, offset, camera position and angle to zero.

workOnce.desc: Switches to the free camera and sets the start angle (+180 degrees, plus the vehicle's orientation if vehId).

work.desc: Computes the center, the position on the circle, the height (with 5% smoothing if snapHeight), orients the camera toward the center (core_camera.setPosRot) then increments the angle by dtReal * speed.
